ask_mic_tap.ha: 🎤 Taɓa Yi magana sannan ka yi magana — ko ka rubuta a ƙasa
ask_mic_tap.en: 🎤 Tap Speak, then talk — or type below

ask_err_perm.ha: An kashe izinin makirufo — taɓa 🔒 a sandar adireshi → ba da izinin makirufo
ask_err_perm.en: Mic permission is off — tap 🔒 in the address bar → allow microphone

ask_err_mic.ha: Ba a iya amfani da makirufo ba — da fatan za a rubuta
ask_err_mic.en: Can't use the microphone — please type instead

ask_err_nospeech.ha: Ba a ji murya ba — taɓa Sake magana
ask_err_nospeech.en: No voice heard — tap Speak again

ask_err_other.ha: Shigar da murya ya gaza ({code}) — da fatan za a rubuta
ask_err_other.en: Voice input failed ({code}) — please type instead
